final_message:
The users API test passes now. `npm test` reports 1 test, 1 pass, 0 fail.

**Cause:** The production schema from `migrations/001_create_users.js` names the column `fullname`, but `src/api/users.js` used `full_name` on both insert and read. The in-memory `Db` rejected the unknown column.

**Fix:** In `src/api/users.js`, I changed the two references from `full_name` to `fullname`, to match the applied schema. Nothing else changed.

I didn't touch `migrations/`. The fix is only in application code, so the DBA-owned schema stays as it is.
